description.value:
Prerequisites: Combat Casting feat

The red mage exercises caution when in danger, casting his spells with more care. While in a threatened square, he may choose to spend a full-round action to cast a spell, with a casting time of standard action or less. Doing so allows him to cast the spell without needing to cast defensively.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Talents)
